text: In the rain-cursed village of Tumbbad, a forgotten god named Hastar lives inside the womb of the goddess of prosperity, [starving for the grain he was denied|wants|feeding on the living]. Vinayak, a bastard son of the local lord, grows up beside a chained old woman and returns fifteen years later [hungry for the hidden treasure|trigger|need and greed]. With [a circle of flour and a dough doll for bait|rules|faith and charms protect], he lowers himself on a rope to steal gold coins from Hastar's loincloth, and keeps going back until he [trains his own son to follow|who_suffers|families and parents].
